verdict.rationale: The evidence documents ROCm as an open-source user-space compute platform (compilers, runtimes, libraries) that runs on Linux. Nothing in the pack covers open-source kernel modules or upstream Linux kernel driver support for the MI355X. An open-source user-space stack is adjacent to the story's driver-openness axis, not evidence of an open kernel driver, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run this GPU on an open driver — open-source kernel modules or upstream Linux support documented by the vendor
